reviews.comment: I've never written a review on here but because Dr. Pals was so awesome I had to! Amazing professor. Always shows up with a positive but chill attitude. Assignments are not easy but are completely doable and material is VERY straightforward. It teaches you a lot about humanity. Take her if you need a 400 level soci course!
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I had a pleasant experience, Dr Pals is great; However, my total grade was never posted, and it still isn't after 5 days of finals over. I didn't think the assignments were hard, but grading was confusing. Feedback was minimal, and not much help for individual assignments. I put in the work, but I don't think it was reciprocated. Very disappointed
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects

reviews.comment: I took online- two ongoing projects throughout the semester, one of which is a group project. About half of your grades come from this. My group was amazing, so we consistently got A+ grades (not very hard at all), but I heard about others who weren't as fortunate. Not many assignments throughout the semester, but all are easy. I'd recommend her!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Go to class and you'll be fine! She does not post her ppts so you have to go and take notes. 3 exams, some article analyses/quizzes, but she drops a lot so it is not very stressful. Also lets you give feedback on her exams and will sometimes drop questions if it is confusing. 10/10 recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Caring

reviews.comment: She is a great professor who really cares about our wellbeing. There is a lot of writing but that is what comes with a SOCI class. 1 group project that spans over the semester, some short essays and discussions, no exams. I loved this class and would take it again!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: There are 6 modules, each containing a short module essay, expert panel, peer evaluations, and discussion, so you are allowed multiple opportunities to complete only 3 module short essays, 2 discussions, and 1 expert panel. There is 1 group project with 3 tasks, and you are also graded on evaluating your classmates' expert panels for each module.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great prof. There were 3 short essays that you could choose from any of the 6 units. Each week you do a discussion post and evaluate a person's expert panel. The other grades come from a group social change project and your own expert evaluation which doesn't take long. The class did not require much work each week. I would take this prof again.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: A wonderful choice
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: three exams, weekly in-class quizzes from textbook readings, one group project. nice teacher, very passionate.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She inputs her political views often but enjoys when students debate with her. You have a quiz every week that is written response over long readings from the book. Tests are fine but you have to ask her to give the class reviews for the tests. Cool lady. Interesting class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Not an easy A, you're definitely going to have to use the textbook. READ the readings for the quizzes, and note everything she presents. study for the exam using her study guide AND the textbook, it helps tremendously! I learned a lot in this course, and it was challenging. Dr. Pals is so nice, caring, intelligent, and funny!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Pals was a great professor and seems like an awesome person. I definitely recommend taking her for Sociology if you get the chance.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Pals was always very clear in what she expected from her students. Grades consist of quizzes every other week over readings in the textbook that aren't too long and are usually interesting, one group presentation, and the exams. Lectures are interesting and exams are based mostly off of them. Attendance not mandatory except for quiz days
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Pals is an amazing professor! You have to do one presentation and each week is a quiz over a chapter you read. Quizzes are not hard if you read. She has great lectures if you pay attention and participate. Attendance is not mandatory (unless quiz days, but you can leave right after), but going to her class is always interesting.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: There are twelve quizzes over chapter readings and she drops the lowest three and makes a test review for each exam. The group project is the presentation of a chapter reading (usually three per chapter) with two others in the class. As long as you do a decent job on the presentation, do the readings, and do okay on the tests you'll get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super easy if you do the readings. Tests are incredibly easy, straight from the book. only stressful part was a weekly quiz once a week worth 3 percent of your grade. And it was stupid to stay in class after the quiz because there were group presentations over the readings we just read. I liked this class and i would take it again. Nice teacher.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: There are 12 quizzes for assigned readings at the end of the chapter. 3 exams based on her notes from lecture. 1 group project based on 1 of the readings and it was easy. So pretty easy and pretty interesting, i would take her again!
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Quizzes over reading at end of chapter that are long and boring. Attendance only mandatory on days of quizzes. Lectures are not from textbook and not posted online. Interesting topics, very theory based and every other class is a group presentation.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Take this class! Yes you have go to class to take the quizzes, but I got As on the tests because I memorized her notes. Its pretty interesting too! one group project, but its pretty blow off because everyone just ends up on their laptop not listening to you (and you get a 100). Basically skimmed the chapters and was fine!! take her!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class is fine. It's a good class to take because it's interesting and online. You will have 6 modules, each one due every 2 weeks. You have a discussion post, short essay, expert panel and one other assignment in each module - no tests. It's not as bad as it sounds - only complaint is she randomly decides to grade hard when she usually is easy

Basically if you don't do the reading you won't pass. She gives quizzes and drops the 2 lowest grades out of 12. She doesn't care for attendance but not going to the lecture or doing the readings you won't do good on the quizzes. The Test are pretty straight forward and easy. TA was Kristie and she was nice and the main grader for the quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I enjoyed the class a lot, but reading the textbook was extremely important in passing. The lectures are great, and the tests correlate to the lectures. Pay attention, but a great class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Pals was very straight forward of what would take for a student to make an A from the first day of class. The quiz schedule was very straight forward and easy as long as you read the readings assigned. If you need help she is always available and she cares about her students understanding the main concepts of class. Lecture is discussion driven
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Attendance is kinda mandatory b/c one quiz a week over ch readings, 12 quizzes total, but the lowest 2 are dropped! 3 exams- application based and medium difficulty. One very easy project presentation that you will get a 100 on. Never even got the book, just skimmed the readings online and took notes. But get the book! Will  make life a lot easier
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The tags sound bad, but it's really not. Dr. Pals is very cool, very accessible, and cares that you learn. The way she taught this class made it a little boring, but on the flip side it's very clearly laid out the expectations. Weekly reading quizzes, a group project, a couple essays, 3 tests. It's really not that hard though. Relatively easy A
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Pretty straightforward class. Not going to be a blow off class but its definitely attainable. Weekly reading quizzes which are not hard. Some midterms that aren't bad. A group project over a reading which is not bad either. She is a good professor and this is an interesting course
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Pretty easy class. There are 6 modules, but she lets you pick and choose what to participate in. You do 3/6 discussion posts, 4/6 short (1 page) essays, and 1 "expert panel". There is a big project where you "create social change" but she breaks it down into super simple steps so its not bad! I would definitely recommend her for SOCI 311 online.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Super easy class if you do the readings and show up when she does her lectures. Have a quiz every week over the readings, but she drops the lowest 4. Need to have all notes to do the review, which is so helpful for the tests. She does go through her slides really fast, so it is easier to type them. Lectures can be kinda boring sometimes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed her class and found her lectures to be interesting. However, she has readings once a week and a short quiz to go with them. As long as you either read the book or go to class during her lectures you should have a solid A or B.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Half of the time she is not teaching which is a plus! on the days she does teach its essential to go to class as the powerpoints are verbatim to the test! If you write the notes by hand its a mistake as people make Cs doing that. Make sure you type the notes because when she puts out the review its literally word for word! Easy class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Kind of a push over. Changed our syllabus halfway through the semester because our first test was screwed up. Stay on top of the readings. For me it was an easy A even without the extra credit. Wants students to succeed. Lectures can be boring sometimes, but overall good. Every other class time students present, so half the time she isn't teaching.
